Subject: Kilimanjaro: Kenya GST details & PO onboarding

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this — we are ready to be onboarded as a supplier for Redwood. Quick summary of our tax details so your team can set us up in your PO/AP system: 

- Company: Kilimanjaro Logistics Ltd
- KRA PIN / VAT reg no: P123456789L (attached KRA certificate)
- Registered for VAT: Yes (standard rate)
- Local currency: KES (we can invoice in USD if preferred)

Could you confirm the preferred invoice format (PDF with VAT line-by-line preferred), PO number placement on the invoice, and which Redwood entity the PO will be issued to? Also attaching our bank accounts spreadsheet and a sample invoice to speed validation.

Attached: KRA-Certificate.pdf, Kilimanjaro-bank-accounts.xlsx, sample-invoice-KIL-001.pdf

Thanks,
Peter Mwangi
Head of Procurement
Kilimanjaro Logistics Ltd
T: +254 700 123456

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kilimanjaro: Kenya GST details & PO onboarding

Hi Peter — thanks for the files, really helpful. Looping in Ben (Finance/AP) and Kim (Tax) so we can get you a PO and confirm payment routing. Next steps from our side: 

1) Please complete our vendor setup form (link below) — this captures legal name + remittance contact + beneficial owner declaration.
2) We will validate the KRA certificate and bank details against the spreadsheet you supplied.
3) AP needs a sample invoice that includes: PO number, invoice number, VAT registration number, VAT amount per line, and a company stamp if possible. Your sample invoice looks fine but please confirm the VAT percentage you applied and whether the recipient is a taxable customer (i.e., standard VAT vs VAT-exempt items).

Notes for our teams:
- Ben: confirm if we should issue PO to Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) or Redwood Europe Limited (we typically split POs by billing entity for currency reasons).
- Kim: please flag any KRA/VAT items that require special handling (reverse charge, fiscal representative).

Vendor form (template): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xk-example-vendor-forms — please upload completed form to that folder or send back as PDF.

If you can send the completed form and a final invoice sample by end of week, I can fast-track the PO.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Peter Mwangi <peter.mwangi@kilimanjaro-logistics.co.ke>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 23 Dec 2026 10:48:00 +0300
Subject: Re: Kilimanjaro: Kenya GST details & PO onboarding

Hi Grace/Ben/Kim — thanks, attached the completed vendor setup form and a final sample invoice with VAT lines. A few quick clarifications: 

- VAT rate used: 16% (standard supplies/services) — shown on sample invoice.
- We are registered for VAT under the KRA PIN above; the attached KRA-Certificate.pdf is the current copy.
- Bank accounts: primary USD account included (Kilimanjaro-bank-accounts.xlsx). Please note the USD account is with Standard Chartered Nairobi.
- Invoicing cadence: we typically issue invoices monthly with PO number referenced.

Attachments: vendor-setup-form-grace-drive-link.txt (contains filename + upload path), KRA-Certificate.pdf, Kilimanjaro-bank-accounts.xlsx, sample-invoice-KIL-001.pdf

Let me know if you need any notarised tax residency docs — happy to provide.

Kind regards,
Peter

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Peter Mwangi <peter.mwangi@kilimanjaro-logistics.co.ke>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kilimanjaro: Kenya GST details & PO onboarding

Hi Peter — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Finance has validated the bank details and KRA certificate. We have created a supplier record and issued PO #RDW-2026-7884 to Kilimanjaro Logistics Ltd. Please observe the following for invoices to be paid without delay: 

- Put PO #RDW-2026-7884 on the first page of the invoice and on the PDF filename.
- Include the KRA PIN and VAT lines exactly as shown on the sample invoice.
- Submit invoices to AP: ap-invoices@redwood.com and cc procurement@redwood.com.
- Payment terms: Net 45 — payments will be sent in USD to the USD account you provided unless you request KES payments and we set up a cross-currency arrangement.

We have tagged your supplier record as: "Non-US VAT-registered supplier — KES/USD" in our system. No withholding applies on Redwood's side for these services per our tax guidance, but please keep your KRA docs current and send any updates to kimberly.park@redwood.com.

PO Attachment: RDW-2026-7884 (will be uploaded to DocuSign — link sent separately).

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
